title: G7 formal preflight could accept a plan that silently dropped an entire public case
evidence: Before repair, protocol_preflight(..., require_complete_plan=True) checked only the set of arms aggregated under checkpoint IDs. A read-only regression probe with two valid public cases and a complete seven-arm G3/G4 plan for only case-1 returned formal_run_allowed_by_protocol=true, so case-2 could be omitted without an error.
remediation: For a complete G7 plan, require every valid public case to have exactly one checkpoint and all seven diagnostic arms independently for both G3 and G4; reject duplicate case/group checkpoints and checkpoint IDs shared across different public cases while allowing one case's G3/G4 forks to share a source checkpoint. Add adversarial tests and rerun the immutable plan preflight.
